title: The line
description: How work moves through the line: where it is, how the agents’ steps end, releases and verifications, model calls and spend, triage, and the traces and logs behind them, for one work item or all.

list.name: Releases
list.textFormat: The line recorded a release’s end

list.name: agent
list.label: Agent
list.description: An agent, or all of them

list.name: work_item
list.label: Work item
list.description: Type a work item’s number, or leave All

list.name: dry_run
list.label: Dry runs
list.description: Whether to count dry runs’ releases and verifications

panels.title: Work items at each stage
panels.description: How many work items stood at each stage over the range, as the store has them. Blank is none; held is amber, because it waits for Martin.

panels.title: Oldest at each stage, of its limit
panels.description: How long the work item longest at each stage has been there, as a share of the stage’s limit (Prometheus’s line:stage_limit_seconds). Past 100% the line is stuck there. Waiting and held have no limit.

panels.title: Time at each stage
panels.description: How long work items stayed at each stage before they left it, in the range: the median and the 95th percentile, from the buckets of line_stage_duration_seconds (a minute to a week). A stage no work item left in the range has no row.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, stage) (increase(line_stage_duration_seconds_bucket[$__range])) and on (stage) sum by (stage) (increase(line_stage_duration_seconds_count[$__range])) > 0)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, stage) (increase(line_stage_duration_seconds_bucket[$__range])) and on (stage) sum by (stage) (increase(line_stage_duration_seconds_count[$__range])) > 0)

defaults.noValue: No work item left a stage in this range

panels.title: Steps in the range
panels.description: Agents’ steps that ended in the range, and their success rate: the share that ended done. A step that failed runs again, so a few are expected.

panels.title: Steps by outcome
panels.description: Steps as they ended, by how: done; failed or out of turns, which count against the step; errored or effects failed, where something around the agent failed; capped, stopped or stale, which run again. Each bar is its interval’s steps, so together they come to about the count beside them.

panels.title: Done, by agent
panels.description: The share of each agent’s steps that ended done in the range. Under half is an agent going round in circles.

panels.title: Holds by cause
panels.description: Holds for Martin the line started in the range, by why: a work item it cannot carry further without his answer. Holds triage makes are triage’s, not counted here.

panels.title: Releases by outcome
panels.description: Releases of the app the line saw end in the range: promoted, rolled back by the canary’s analysis, aborted, or errored. Dry runs are counted only when the dry_run variable says so.

panels.title: Verifications by sense
panels.description: After a release, each sense looks again at what its work item was for: cleared, or the signal persists. Persists sends the work item back.

panels.title: The app’s traffic, stable and canary
panels.description: Requests a second through Traefik to the app’s stable version and to its canary: the split a release’s canary analysis judges. Outside a release, the canary has none.

panels.title: Spend in the range
panels.description: What the gateway spent on models in the range, in US dollars, every priced call counted as it was made (factory_gateway_spend_usd_total). Replays and the local model cost nothing.

panels.title: Spend by agent
panels.description: What each agent’s model calls cost, in US dollars. Each bar is its interval’s spend, so together they come to about the figure beside them.

panels.title: Spend against the caps
panels.description: What the day’s and the month’s windows have spent, as a share of the profile’s caps; at 100% the gateway refuses every paid call until the window ends. A profile with no monthly cap shows the day alone.

panels.title: Refusals and provider errors
panels.description: Calls refused in the range at a spend cap, by cap, and errors a provider answered with, by status. Good is none.

panels.title: Model calls by outcome
panels.description: Calls the gateway took: answered by a provider, replayed from a cassette, refused (a cap, or no cassette to replay), or failed. Each bar is its interval’s calls.

defaults.noValue: No model calls in this range

panels.title: Step duration by agent, last 24 hours
panels.description: How long agents’ steps took, the median and the 95th percentile by agent, from their spans (TraceQL metrics). Tempo reads a day at most, so this panel always shows the last 24 hours.

defaults.noValue: No steps in the last 24 hours

panels.title: Model calls by agent and model
panels.description: Each agent’s calls to each model in the range: how many, the 95th percentile of their duration, tokens in and out, the share of input read from the prompt cache, and what they cost.

targets.expr: sum by (agent, model) (increase(gateway_tokens_total{agent=~"$agent", kind="cache_read"}[$__range])) / sum by (agent, model) (increase(gateway_tokens_total{agent=~"$agent", kind=~"input|cache_read"}[$__range]))

defaults.noValue: No model calls in this range

panels.title: Inbox
panels.description: Signals waiting in the inbox for triage now, and those left there after their last attempt. Waiting signals clear in seconds; one out of attempts needs a look at triage’s logs.

panels.title: Signals by source
panels.description: Signals triage took, by where they came from: a sense (probe, crawler, metrics, logs, canary, report) or the planner. Each bar is its interval’s signals.

panels.title: Signals by outcome
panels.description: What triage did with the signals in the range: opened a ticket, added evidence or a count to one, filed a report or a finding, reopened one, or held it for Martin.

panels.title: Signal to ticket
panels.description: How long from a signal reaching the inbox to triage opening its ticket, in the range: the median and the 95th percentile.

defaults.noValue: No ticket opened in this range

panels.title: Recent steps, last 24 hours
panels.description: The agents’ steps, newest first, from their traces, for the work item and agent chosen above. Select a trace to follow the step through its GitHub and Kubernetes calls to each model call. Tempo searches a day at most.

defaults.noValue: No steps in the last 24 hours

panels.title: Warnings and errors
panels.description: Lines the line and its runners logged at warn, error or worse in the range, for the work item chosen above. A few warnings are routine; an error is worth reading.

panels.title: The line’s logs
panels.description: What the line said, newest first, for the work item chosen above. Each line names its work item, job and agent; a line with a trace opens it.

defaults.noValue: The line logged nothing in this range

panels.title: The runners’ logs
panels.description: What the agents’ runner pods said, newest first, for the work item chosen above: preparing the work, the agent’s turns, and handing back.

defaults.noValue: No runner logged in this range
